cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we plan Mum's apology dinner, why did she spend her birthday outside the restaurant?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you forget, or assume I'd book it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I assumed you'd do it. Now your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even after telling Mum it was confirmed? Give me that bit, then you get the present.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happens when it rains?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happens when it rains?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll get your boiler running. I know these controls. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll need someone on the boiler.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're still establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions so he can concentrate on readings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get your boiler running. I know these controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll need someone on the boiler.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're still establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions so he can concentrate on readings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tune your violin for the audition. I work by ear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've tightened that string until it snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That string couldn't hold pitch. I've saved you a failure onstage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The audition panel heard it snap. They're asking if you know what you're doing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I rejected an unreliable string. Ask for their spare violin; I'll check that one before I approve it.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My tea's stronger than yours. I can handle it without milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same teapot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First to finish, then. I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've finished. I'm making another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fewest refills wins, then. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The car won't start. Excellent chance for a walk. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's raining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And a free shower!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My shoe's leaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant. The shower's finally reached your feet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car won't start. Excellent chance for a walk.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My shoe's leaking.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our show sold no tickets. We can rehearse uninterrupted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for our deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better! We'll hire the pub upstairs. People already go there voluntarily.

beats.text: They've kept the deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.text: Wonderful—a touring production! I'll carry the scenery; you bring exact change. We can try the opening scene between stops.
